CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_user_create_aplicacao_for_cliente(_cliente_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
                                                                                                                              SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND _cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND public.can_user_access_cliente(_cliente_id) AND (
                                                                                                                                  public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                      OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                          OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                              OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'tecnico_agronomo'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                                  OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'consultor_tecnico'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                                      OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'aplicador'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                                          OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'operador_onfarm'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                                              OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'cliente_produtor'::public.app_role)
                                                                                                                                                                );
                                                                                                                                                                $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.h15_actor_organization()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT p.organization_id FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id AND o.ativo IS TRUE WHERE p.user_id=auth.uid() AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=p_user AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.senha_provisoria IS FALSE)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_org_admin_invites i WHERE i.user_id=p_user AND (i.access_operation_status='processing' OR (i.access_valid_after IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid()=p_user AND to_timestamp(COALESCE((auth.jwt()->>'iat')::bigint,0))<=i.access_valid_after)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_actor_organization()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.h15_actor_organization(); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.technical_actor_ready(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_user IS NULL OR p_user IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()
   OR COALESCE((auth.jwt()->>'iat') ~ '^[0-9]{1,10}$',false) IS FALSE THEN false
 ELSE CASE WHEN (auth.jwt()->>'iat')::bigint <= 0 THEN false
 ELSE platform_private.h15_actor_organization() IS NOT NULL
 AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user) END END;
$function$
